name: Can under-cabinet lighting be controlled with a dimmer switch?

mainEntity.name: Can under-cabinet lighting be controlled with a dimmer switch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, most modern under-cabinet LED lighting systems are compatible with dimmer switches, allowing you to adjust the light intensity. It's crucial to use a dimmer specifically designed for LED lighting to prevent flickering or damage. A practical tradeoff is that while dimmers add versatility, they may increase initial installation cost and require specific wiring knowledge for proper setup. Hometelligent Inc. ensures correct dimmer compatibility and installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Many LED under-cabinet lights work with dimmers, but use LED-compatible dimmers to avoid issues.
